name: – Gerben-Jan Gerbrandy – After § 149 – Am 58
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section I – European Parliament
part_text: 149 a. Recalls that in 2024, more than 10 million euro was spent by European political parties on election campaigns; emphasises the high sensitivity of this type of expenditure with regard to compliance with Member States’ electoral law and the differences in resources that each European party can mobilise; requests that this type of expenditure be the subject of a more detailed supplementary report as part of the accountability process to ensure the proper use of Union funds and compliance with Member States’ electoral law;
